T: They killed his dog. Feed yours first.
D: A retired hitman comes back to settle the score with the Russian mob.
P: Serve the drinks when John sits at the bar in the Continental.
S: the coins that pay for everything in his world
Parmesan crisps: grated parmesan in small rounds on baking paper, baked at 190C for 6 minutes until lacy and golden, a crack of black pepper on each.
drinks at the bar where no business gets done
Green olives warmed in olive oil with orange peel, rosemary and garlic, served with salted almonds.
the Russian boss getting very bad news about his son
Warm blini topped with sour cream and salmon roe, buttered rye with pickled herring and onion, and fridge-cold dill pickles, all laid out beside the frozen vodka.
M: Beef short ribs browned, braised at 150C for 4 hours in red wine, stock, garlic and thyme, glossy sauce reduced, over creamy polenta.
the quiet house before the trouble
Rib eye dry-brined overnight, seared in cast iron, butter, garlic and rosemary basted, pulled at 54C and rested, with a sharp green salad.
W: Peanut butter shortbread cut into little bone shapes, baked at 170C for 12 minutes, half dipped in dark chocolate. Human food only.
K: Addy behind the bar, the usual
60ml bourbon neat in a heavy glass, a single large ice cube if you must.

s.note: the coins that pay for everything in his world
s.how: Grate 150g parmesan finely. Spoon into small rounds on a tray lined with baking paper, leaving space between. Bake at 190C for 6 minutes until lacy and golden. Crack black pepper over each and cool on the tray to crisp.

s.note: drinks at the bar where no business gets done
s.how: Warm 300g green olives in 60ml olive oil with 3 strips orange peel, 2 sprigs rosemary and 2 sliced garlic cloves over low heat for 5 minutes. Toast 100g almonds with a pinch of salt. Serve both in small bowls, the hotel bar way.

m.how: Brown 2kg beef short ribs, add 375ml red wine, 500ml stock, 4 garlic cloves and thyme. Braise covered at 150C for 4 hours. Reduce the sauce until glossy. Cook 200g polenta in 1L water with butter and parmesan and spoon the ribs over.

w.how: Beat 100g butter with 100g peanut butter and 80g icing sugar, then mix in 200g flour. Roll out, cut into small bone shapes and bake at 170C for 12 minutes. Cool and half dip in 100g melted dark chocolate. Human food only.

d.note: Addy behind the bar, the usual
d.how: Pour 60ml bourbon into each of four heavy glasses. Offer a single large ice cube to anyone who wants it. Sip it slowly at the bar, and don't do business on the premises.
